note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of 816ce1ce4c, 2cbd255ba4, 2e5c2d012a, d22b811ce4 or 1a2ccaeef8 (phase 5 of spec-filter-wire-0-umbrella, the per-peer text filter chain deleted). RFC 7999 Section 4 read: "Without an explicit configuration directive set by the operator, network elements SHOULD NOT discard traffic destined towards IP prefixes that are tagged with the BLACKHOLE community." The moved unit TestBlackholeCommunityLeavesNextHopAloneWithoutAgreement dropped only the out.Update != "" half of its no-change check, because d22b811ce4 removed the text Update field from the filter protocol: an answer can no longer carry a change there, so the remaining len(out.Sets) == 0 with Action accept is the whole of what an accept can change. Positive still: a modify matching only 65001:100 answers accept with no set for the 65535:666 route; negative TestBlackholeCommunityRewritesNextHopWhenAgreed still requires modify with exactly next-hop set "192.0.2.1". RIB carriers byte-identical. Ran the tagged units under ./le job run at HEAD (-tags ze_bgp, -v): PASS (scratch audit-p5-units-v.log). Verdict unchanged: enforced.
